title: Can You Go on a Boat Trip in Madeira If You Cannot Swim?
description: Yes. You can enjoy a boat trip in Madeira without swimming: you stay seated on deck, the swim stop is your choice, and the Sunset Trip has no swimming at all.
heroAlt: Guest sitting dry under the boat canopy while two friends swim below the cliffs at Fajã dos Padres
keywords: can you go on a boat trip if you cannot swim
do i need to swim for a boat trip
afraid of water boat trip madeira

images.prompt: Late morning at Fajã dos Padres, Madeira. Seen from the deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, stopped with the engine off. In the foreground, one adult seen from behind sits on a grey cushioned seat in the shade of the canopy, holding a glass, fully dressed and dry. Below, two small swimmers in the clear blue water near the boat. Behind them the tall dark cliff and the green terraces of the fajã with a few small buildings at its foot. Natural light, true colours, calm sea with a light ripple.
images.alt: Guest sitting dry under the boat canopy while two friends swim below the cliffs at Fajã dos Padres

images.prompt: Close detail on the deck of a white motor boat: an orange life jacket with its buckles done up lying on a grey cushioned seat, sunlight and a strip of blue sea behind, Madeira south coast, natural colours, no people.
